steps.title: Human opens a blank A4 landscape page
LLM creates four labelled blocks, connectors, annotations and a logo through MCP
steps.detail: 10 objects in one atomic transaction, revision 1

steps.title: The editor visibly shows the result
steps.detail: every label is drawn on the canvas; editor screenshot saved

steps.title: LLM requests a PNG preview and notices one alignment problem
steps.detail: preview 64203 bytes; ERP sits 11.3 pt below CRM (inspect_layout reports 1 issues)

steps.title: LLM aligns only the affected elements
steps.detail: changed 1 object(s); the verifier checks the rest are byte-identical

steps.title: Human drags one element and changes one fill colour
steps.detail: 'data' moved 56.7 pt right; 'billing' fill is #fde68a; revision 4

steps.title: LLM reads changes since its previous revision and preserves the human edits
steps.detail: stale write refused (revision_conflict); get_changes named the human's 2 objects; the follow-up edit left both human edits intact

steps.title: Human asks for a logo replacement; the LLM finds the approved asset by id
Only that image object changes
steps.detail: exactly one object changed: the image now points at asset:esg-global-primary

steps.title: File opens in Visio with editable objects
steps.detail: Visio 16.0: all 10 objects are Visio shapes carrying their UUID; text edited through Visio's object model

steps.title: Moving a connected shape in Visio keeps its connector attached
steps.detail: all 3 connectors still have 2 connections; one ends at y=3.63 in beside Billing's centre y=3.20

steps.title: VSDX embedded in Word activates and stays editable as a Visio object
steps.detail: embedded as Visio.Drawing, activated, edited, saved, reopened and reactivated: the edit persisted

steps.title: VSDX is reopened in the POC and agent ids still resolve (the app's own export)
steps.detail: 10 ids resolve; identity preserved=12, generated=0, repaired=0

steps.title: The Visio-saved file reopens in the POC; agent ids still resolve and Visio's edits arrive
steps.detail: 10 ids resolve; Visio's text edit and 0.5 in move arrived; the human's fill colour survived
